# Journal of Abnormal & Social Psychology

> [!CAUTION]
> **Publication status:** Appears to have ceased publication — OpenAlex records **no publications since 1964** (checked 2026-07-30, ISSN 0096-851X). This entry is retained for historical reference and for rejection-fallback context, but **should not be recommended as a live submission target**. Renamed **Journal of Abnormal Psychology** in 1965 (and **Journal of Personality and Social Psychology** was split off the same year); the abnormal-psychology title has since become **Journal of Psychopathology and Clinical Science**. If this is an OpenAlex indexing gap rather than a real closure, please open an issue (see [docs/GOVERNANCE.md](../../../../../docs/GOVERNANCE.md)).
